stem: Which statement BEST explains why Germans migrated out of their country?

options.label: A
options.text: They were part of a forced migration to provide labor in America.

options.label: B
options.text: They were fleeing a major famine caused by crop failure.

options.label: C
options.text: They were attracted by economic opportunities and available land.

options.label: D
options.text: They were searching for gold and other natural sources of wealth in America.

visual_elements: multiple choice question with four lettered answer options
